name: Bach Ma Temple
summary: Bach Ma is the temple at 76 Hang Buom, a stop on the walk through the lanes. From 8 December 2025 the ticket is 20,000 VND. The 2025 notice prints 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30, and a Friday-to-Sunday evening that closes at 21:30 in one report and 21:00 in another. A 2018 door board prints a shorter day and a Monday close. Read the board at the gate.
heroCaption: The yellow hall, tiled roof, and dragons on Hang Buom

notice.title: The clocks do not match
notice.body: The 2025 notice and a 2018 door board print different hours. Read the board at the gate before you plan the afternoon.

body: The hall sits on Hang Buom: yellow walls, a tiled roof, and dragons along the ridge, with red lanterns by the door. The tourism notice gives the address as 76 Hang Buom, Hoan Kiem. It is a stop on the walk, not a separate day.

From 8 December 2025 the ticket is 20,000 VND a visit, under a city council resolution the Hoan Kiem and Old Quarter management board is carrying out. Children under 16 are free. If a child has no papers, the notice uses a height under 1.3 m. A 50 percent reduction covers students 16 and over, older visitors, and the other groups that notice names. VnExpress, citing the same board, also prints free entry on 23 November and on the last day of the lunar year plus the first two days of Tet. The tourism notice does not restate those free days.

Day hours on the tourism notice are 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30 every day, plus 19:00–21:30 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. VnExpress prints the same day hours and an evening close of 21:00. A 2018 photograph of the door board prints 08:00–11:00 and 14:00–17:00, Monday closed instead of Sunday, and 08:00–21:00 on the 1st and 15th of the lunar month. Use the board that is on the gate the day you go.

figures.caption: The altar inside Bach Ma, with the white horse
figures.alt: The altar inside Bach Ma Temple, centered on a white horse between two cranes

gettingThere: The temple is at 76 Hang Buom, inside the lanes north of Hoan Kiem Lake. Walk from the lake. No published minute count was on the tourism notice or the VnExpress report. Minutes: check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem Lake
legs.body: Walk north into the lanes and stop at 76 Hang Buom. The tourism notice does not print a minute count. Check the minutes on arrival.

hours: 2025 notice: 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30 daily; Friday–Sunday evening 19:00–21:30 (Vietnam National Administration of Tourism) or 19:00–21:00 (VnExpress). 2018 door board: 08:00–11:00 and 14:00–17:00, and 08:00–21:00 on the 1st and 15th of the lunar month.
closed: The 2025 notice prints no weekly close. The 2018 door board prints Monday closed instead of Sunday.
admissionNote: From 8 December 2025, 20,000 VND a visit. Under 16 free, or under 1.3 m when there are no papers. Severe disability is free. A 50 percent reduction covers students from 16, older visitors, and the other groups named in the tourism notice. One person who qualifies twice still pays half, not a further cut. VnExpress adds free entry on 23 November and on the last lunar day plus the first two days of Tet. The tourism notice does not restate those days.
